evidence.quote: un rapport sur les conditions de déploiement des centres de données sur le territoire national

summary.short: Proposed French law (Senate-adopted at first reading) letting the government qualify data-centre projects as projets d'intérêt national majeur, with a local stakeholder committee and consultation steps, enabling grid-capacity reservation for energy-intensive projects, and requiring a government report within six months of promulgation.
summary.long: The bill, adopted by the Senate at first reading and transmitted to the Assemblée nationale on 26 March 2026, sets rules for data-centre siting in France. It lets the land-use master plan propose siting guidance (Art. 1) and lets the government qualify, by decree, data-centre projects of particular importance as projets d'intérêt national majeur (Art. 1 bis). Publication of such a decree requires a project committee organised by the project holder, with a presentation file sent at least one month before the first meeting, fifteen days for written observations and fifteen days for the holder's reply. The administrative authority may refuse a building permit for a data centre in an area with structural water-resource tensions. Further articles amend public-consultation rules and grid-connection derogations for such projects, and let the energy minister ask the transmission system operator to reserve connection capacity for electricity-intensive projects, subject to a possible additional connection contribution whose calculation principles the energy regulator approves. Articles 2 and 3, and Article 4 I, are deleted. Article 4 II requires a government report to Parliament within six months of promulgation on deployment conditions for data centres.

notes: Text is the Senate-adopted bill as transmitted to the Assemblée nationale (first reading), deliberated 25 March 2026 and registered 26 March 2026; the registry status is pending. Articles 2 and 3 are marked Supprimés and Article 4 I is deleted; Article 1er bis and Article 4 II are marked nouveau. This pass covers relations, entities and notes only. The text does not name the code containing article L. 342-12 (Art. 1er bis IV), so no relation is recorded for it. The definition of data centre in Art. 1er bis I bis applies only to the first paragraph of that section. Several entities are described by function rather than by name.

thresholds.note: No numeric cutoff found. The qualification of a data centre as a project of major national interest (Art. 1er bis, I, 2°, I bis) refers to investment, installed capacity and support for domestic ecosystems without any number; the water-resource criterion (territories with structural tensions on water resources) and the IV contribution for electricity-intensive projects carry no value; the 'set by decree' delegation covers the qualification and the Conseil d'État conditions for the imperative reason of overriding public interest (Art. 1er bis, I, 3°/5° XIII) but states no numeric value. Procedural periods (one month, fifteen days, six months) are events, not thresholds.

enforcement.note: The text (Art. 1er bis I bis, Art. 4) contains no fines, penalties, criminal sanctions, licence revocation, benefit clawback, suspension or blocking. The power to refuse a building permit where water resources are structurally strained is an administrative refusal, not coded as a sanction. No cross-reference to a penalty regime is found in the text.
